method: Fresh copies of the clean post-hol.ml plus candle/compute.ml DMTCP checkpoint. GNU time measured the complete restart and load because Candle time APIs are deliberately deterministic. A separate marker-only restart measures the fixed checkpoint cost. The profile reconstructs all program semantics in the kernel and checks that the reification, reflected computation, and final interval-soundness theorems have no assumptions.

input.description: six-variable Taylor-shaped polynomial with first-order terms and a lower-triangular quadratic form

conclusion: Compositional reconstruction removes the immediate proof-generation bottleneck: the complete profile is at most 6.19 seconds above a marker-only restart, while the superseded monolithic reconstruction had not completed after 390 seconds. Exact rational endpoint growth is now the scaling concern: only 27 terms already produce 226-bit denominators and 230-231-bit numerators. The next nonlinear prototype should preserve the single coarse proof boundary while evaluating whether bounded dyadic directed rounding is required for substantial checker workloads.
